audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 matches 56.41% WR over 3847 games; the fear-on-dash framing is genuinely apt — Sylas's W and E are both dashes. Content layer is well grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[2] claims 'no permanent owner' while both layers and the packet chart read Vex on all 7 rows.
audit.why: Chart layers already agree (full and content both Vex 0-6); only the report[2] sentence contradicts them.
audit.corrected: report[2].t rewritten to state the Vex-held chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the full layer never names Sylas's abilities. Cooldowns field had no digits. Hijack (steals Vex's R, 80/55/30s) never mentioned in full layer. Kingslayer heal named only generically.
audit.why: Kit: E Abscond/Abduct 13/12/11/10/9s two-part dash, W Kingslayer 12 down to 6s with champion heal, R Hijack 80/55/30s, P Petricite Burst post-spell chains.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns folded into cooldowns, trading, mid, loading, dos/donts.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Sylas wins by baiting your fear with the first dash, landing the chain-pull, and healing through your burst with Kingslayer.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Q his ranged stance, then fear the E chain-pull the moment he commits — his W heal needs 400 range, and a feared Sylas heals off nobody at all.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Grinding auto-range time against Petricite Burst — his post-spell chains and Kingslayer heal win melee time; you win the 1200-range Q war.

edits.before: Ahead, gloom harder: zone Sylas with marked-rotation threat, R every skirmish his team starts, and reset through the kills — fed Vex makes mobility a typo.
edits.after: Ahead, gloom harder: zone Sylas off the wave, R the skirmishes he starts, and buy Grievous Wounds so Kingslayer can't drag him back into fights you won.

edits.before: - Vex vs Sylas - Track: Sylas Abscond / Abduct. - Mark before you trade — unmarked rotations are half rotations. - No commits into Abscond / Abduct. - The ultimate closes arguments; it doesn’t open them.
edits.after: - Vex vs Sylas - Track: Sylas Abscond / Abduct. - Hold the fear for the chain-pull, not the first dash. - No commits into Abscond / Abduct. - Grievous Wounds early — Kingslayer heals every 6s at max rank.

edits.before: Mark and bolt — your trades are honest and your passive makes his mobility dishonest. Bank Gloom procs like currency.
edits.after: His only approach is a 13s-cooldown dash — poke Q from 1200 range, bank the glow, and make every step-in cost him a fear.

edits.before: Luden's onward, hunt the skirmishes: R into river fights, fear the convergence, and reset off whatever dies. Your range is wherever the missile reaches.
edits.after: Luden's onward, watch his Hijack — 80s rank 1 with a copy of your own R inside it. R the river skirmishes while his E is down; he can't follow or flee.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Personal Space for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct is 13s at rank 1 — his only way in; punish hard while it's down and step up only on its downtime. - Kingslayer falls from 12s to 6s: take anti-heal early. - Hijack is 80s rank 1 and holds your stolen R.

edits.before: Carry by punishing motion — every dash in their comp is a fear you scheduled; your job is being where their mobility wants to go.
edits.after: Carry by holding the answer: every fight he starts opens with the E chain — fear it, R the fallout, and his stolen R finds no one.

edits.before: You are the engage tax: their dive comp feeds your fears, your R feeds on their commitments, and the carry they sent dies mid-dash, repeatedly.
edits.after: His dive is always Abscond / Abduct — a free fear if you hold it. Save the glow and R for his commit and he dies before Kingslayer ramps.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: His E comes in two dashes — hold the pulse for the second one, the chain-pull that commits him, and the Q-W follow-up dies inside the fear.

edits.after: With passive and W down you're a 475-range mage against a brawler whose W falls to 6s — back off until the glow returns, then re-engage on it.

edits.after: Vex holds every stage — his all-in needs a dash your kit was built to interrupt.

notes: Chart agrees on both layers (Vex 0-6) and matches the 56.41% WR — no chart edits. Packet defect (no Sylas ability names in full layer) resolved: Abscond/Abduct, Kingslayer, Petricite Burst, Hijack now named with real cooldowns. Anti-heal missing-interaction covered in ahead, loading, cooldowns and late (report[8] already had it). Hijack note: what Sylas does with a stolen Vex R is situational — stated only that he holds a copy, no speculation on its value to him. phases[].why strings are the lane-generic fear template but are factually apt for a dash enemy; left as-is (not in the mandatory sweep). breakdown.spikes and breakdown.feeding remain templated — nothing Sylas-specific to add without invention.
